2026_04_PIT_CLE.headline: Steelers’ edge pressure meets Cleveland’s reshuffled protection on a short week
2026_04_PIT_CLE.paragraph1: Pittsburgh enters the Thursday turnaround with T.J. Watt and Alex Highsmith creating a direct stress test for a Cleveland offensive line preparing to reshuffle around center. Browns coach Todd Monken has Deshaun Watson working behind that protection, while Aaron Rodgers faces a Cleveland defense featuring Denzel Ward and an active front. With both clubs operating on compressed preparation, protection calls, negative plays and which quarterback stays ahead of the rush should shape the AFC North matchup.
2026_04_PIT_CLE.model_rationale: Pittsburgh’s pass-rush advantage and Cleveland’s protection uncertainty create the clearest matchup leverage, while the short turnaround increases the importance of clean quarterback decisions and avoiding drive-killing mistakes.
